<div class="card-body">
'''Hunchback''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ハンチバック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手が、ハンチのいるロケーションに隣接した位置でフォース消耗を宣言した直後に使用する。1フォースを使用し、相手のフォースデッキを見る。名前に“バック／帰還／背（中）”が含まれているカードを1枚選んでゲームから除外できる。その後フォースデッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの場所に置くこと。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hunchback-PSA-156625020.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">どうしたんだ、その背中のコブ？</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hunchback.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent declares a Force drain at a location adjacent to Hunch's location. Use 1 Force to look at opponent's Force Pile. You may choose one card whose name includes "back / return / spine (hump)" and place it out of play. Then shuffle and cut the Force Pile and return it.

'''Lore:'''
What's with that hump on your back?

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese looks for バック, 帰還, or 背（中） in the title; the English looks for back.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hunchback]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
